title: Clinical Documentation Companion contract v1
description: Chains note-context -> document-derive -> coding-rationale -> quality-gap-check -> handoff-draft. Citations ride the contract: every fact, every supported claim element and every derived document carries its grounding. Plugin 1.0.1 adds additive, backward-compatible fields: messages, care_plan_update, referral_decision, halt, omission/code-change refusal logs and note_citation on gaps and unsupported flags. Plugin 1.0.2: `encounter` is optional in an unsigned-note halt record; override_attempts_refused.detected_via gains 'messages' (words from the live chat message). Plugin 1.0.3: cited_fact gains optional statements[] (one cited entry per documented medication, instruction or follow-up statement).

standards_alignment.family: HL7 FHIR R4 / US Core 6.1 / USCDI v3
standards_alignment.rationale: Clinical encounter and quality-measure data map to existing FHIR resources, so customer EHR data lands without a universal data model (Industry Templates standard section 6).

field_mappings.note_signature: FHIR DocumentReference.authenticator + .docStatus ('final' = signed) for the US Core Clinical Note
field_mappings.note_facts.*.citation.source: FHIR DocumentReference.id of the signed note
field_mappings.note_facts.*.citation.locator: line/section locator within the note narrative (DocumentReference.content)

standards_alignment.not_mapped_reason: Refusal, escalation and provenance records are plugin governance artefacts with no honest FHIR R4 equivalent; they are deliberately left unmapped rather than forced onto a resource.

anyOf.description: Unsigned-note halt (clinical-doc-rules.md #5): the halt record needs no encounter - note-context stops before extracting one.

citation.description: Grounding for one asserted item. Rides the contract so provenance survives every hand-off (non-negotiable #4).

source.description: Signed-note document identifier (FHIR DocumentReference.id) or reference document.

locator.description: Line, section or span within the source.

statements.description: Plugin 1.0.3. Every relevant statement the note documents for a multi-statement fact (active_medications, patient_instructions, follow_up_plan, referral_indicated), each with its own citation, so downstream drafts never lose a second medication, instruction or follow-up item. When present and non-empty, `value` is true and `citation` repeats the first statement's citation.

text.description: The statement as documented in the note.

action_level.description: Draft-first (non-negotiable #5). L2/L3 are not permitted by this plugin.

encounter.description: Required on every payload except an unsigned-note halt record (halt.halted = 'unsigned_note' with note_signature.signed = false), where it is optional (1.0.2).

note_signature.description: FHIR DocumentReference.docStatus/authenticator for the encounter note. signed must be true before any skill runs (clinical-doc-rules.md #5).

note_facts.description: Documented findings. Every entry is a cited_fact; an uncited assertion is not documented (clinical-doc-rules.md #1).

claim.description: Visit level and diagnosis codes already on the claim; coding-rationale rationalises them, it never selects one.

supported_by.description: note_facts key the coder asserts supports this element.

request_text.description: Verbatim requester wording; scanned deterministically for override intent (clinical-doc-rules.md #2).

note_citation.description: the note's own citation for the absent/false fact, when note-context recorded one

detected_via.description: 'request_text' = wording from request_text and other configured text fields; 'messages' = wording from the live chat message(s) in `messages` (1.0.2).

messages.description: The live requester message(s) from chat, verbatim. Every skill appends the user's message here before running the engine so override, code-change and omission wording is scanned deterministically (clinical-doc-rules.md #2, #7).

referral_decision.description: Set by document-derive whenever a referral is requested or considered. drafted=false with the reason and citation when the note does not indicate one (referral_letter is then null).

halt.description: Written by any skill that stops before producing output (e.g. unsigned note). Nothing else is produced.
